raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 delivered 27 transactions twice: a record_version 1 and a record_version 2 that differ only in amount. The silver step does not deduplicate, so these txn_ids appear twice in silver and are double-counted in every gold table. The source's record_version column marks revisions, so keeping the highest version per txn_id (the corrected record) gives the right data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) t WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
